title: winget manifest fixes from the 072 audit (DisplayName, ProductCode, PrivacyUrl)
reason: waits for microsoft/winget-pkgs#426090 - tools/winget/templates/ must not change while the PR is open
problem: The audit of PR #426090 (2026-09-30) found manifest inaccuracies a winget moderator is likely to ask about: AppsAndFeaturesEntries.DisplayName does not match what the installer writes (AppVerName), ProductCode is only in AppsAndFeaturesEntries and not at installer level, and PrivacyUrl may be required (the template line exists since feature 083). The installer template comment still gives the refuted reason "the pipeline runs elevated".
evidence: specs/072-winget-distribution/REMAINING-WORK.md §P0 (P0.3, P0.6, P0.7, 'Repository record fixes' - template comment), re-checked by the migration at 7993914c: DisplayName and installer-level ProductCode still open; `tools/winget/templates/installer.yaml.in:13-21` still has the refuted reason; `locale.en-US.yaml.in:42` has the PrivacyUrl line. Migrated from specs/NEXT-WORK.md §6 ('Read 072/REMAINING-WORK.md § P0 before anything else here') at 7993914c - the two migration parts pointed at each other, so the consolidation made this item.
expected: The manifests generated from the templates state DisplayName and ProductCode as the installed program reports them, carry PrivacyUrl, and the template comments give the true reasons - done together with the next submission (072 P0 'Recommended plan' step 2).
approach: Change the templates only when #426090 is settled; dry-run `tools/winget/publish.ps1 -Version <v> -LocalFile …` and validate the output before any submission.
notes: The other parts of the 072 audit: the submission itself (current release, VC++ runtime risk of 0.1.7, the Policy-Test-1.2 waiver, re-pointing the PR) are steps of `winget-submit-release-after-pr-426090`; the stale records outside the templates are `winget-records-stale-claims-from-072-audit`.
log: audit of #426090 recorded in 072/REMAINING-WORK.md §P0 - not acted on

title: Stale winget claims in project records and publish.ps1 order (072 audit)
problem: Project records repeat claims the 072 audit refuted: `specs/FEATURE-HISTORY.md` (072 entry, ~L281-283) says `publish.ps1` refuses to run without PrivilegesRequiredOverridesAllowed; 072's `fix-log.md` ~128-131 makes the check-09 claim; and `tools/winget/publish.ps1` substitutes placeholders (~L194/195) before it strips comment lines (~L203), so a placeholder inside a comment is substituted needlessly.
evidence: specs/072-winget-distribution/REMAINING-WORK.md §P0 'Repository record fixes' (L157-163); re-checked by the migration at 7993914c: all three still present. Migrated from specs/NEXT-WORK.md §6 ('… and stale records') at 7993914c.
expected: The records state what is true (or name the correction), and publish.ps1 strips comments before substituting - verified by a dry run producing byte-identical manifests.
approach: Records: add a dated correction rather than rewriting history. publish.ps1 is outside tools/winget/templates/, so it may change while #426090 is open - but run the dry run and compare the output.

title: CLAUDE.md names a branch ai-main that does not exist
problem: `CLAUDE.md` (Build, last bullet) says `main` = stable, `ai-main` = AI-assisted development. No branch `ai-main` exists locally; features are branched from `main` and fast-forwarded into it (and autonomous runs of feature 242 work the same way).
evidence: `git branch --list ai-main` empty on 2026-10-17 at 7993914c (feature 242, fix-log *Measurements*).
expected: `CLAUDE.md` and `architecture/12-project-reference.md` describe the branches as they are used, after the maintainer says whether `ai-main` exists on origin or should.
approach: Ask the maintainer (or check `git ls-remote origin`), then correct the line.
